result.title: Effect of class proportion shifts on classifier curvature
result.summary: Changing the class mix can alter mean loss without changing the classifier. To distinguish this reweighting from changes in the model itself, we studied ten-class CIFAR-10 classification in separate branches for two target classes, measuring the trace of the loss Hessian with respect to the output-layer parameters on fixed images of each target class. Across ten new initialisations, after 60 updates to the output layer with frozen features, the trace changed by -0.152% on average in branches where the target class share rose from 10% to 19%, and by +0.071% in branches where it fell to 1%, relative to each branch's initial trace. These changes do not isolate the effect of class share from that of the assigned training images. We developed a forecast based on initial class gradients after examining the first experiment's results and then tested it prospectively without modification. For direct increases from 10% to 19%, rather than increases after a deficit, its mean absolute error was 0.022 percentage points on the initial-trace scale, compared with 0.152 for a zero-change forecast and 0.104 for equally weighted gradients. Using the assigned class proportions improved the forecast of how much the trace would change.

AI.brief_summary: 在 CIFAR-10 十分类中分目标类训练分支，冻结特征只更新输出层，测量损失 Hessian 迹随类别比例变化，并用初始类梯度构造迹变化的预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是单模态图像分类下类别重加权对输出层曲率的影响，与 VLM 内部视觉状态、latent 生成、证据使用或停止决策均无实质联系，其曲率度量限于输出层参数且混杂训练图像分配，难以构成可核查的表示几何借鉴线索。
